title.zh: v2.0.43 钢琴卷帘片段新建/保存/录制闭环、工作区功能键4组胶囊聚合与精简折叠、轨道头独立折叠与声学类型指示器
title.en: v2.0.43 Piano Roll Clip New/Export/Record Workflow, 4-Pill Workspace Toolbar Grouping & Compact Fold, Track Row Collapsing & Category Badges

highlights.zh: **钢琴卷帘片段新建、保存与实时录制闭环（Item 3: Piano Roll Clip New, Save/Export & Realtime Record）**：在钢琴卷帘顶部 Deck 1 新增三大核心工程操作：「新建片段 (New Clip)」（支持安全二次确认弹窗、重置旋律音符并拥有完整撤销历史支持）、「保存/导出片段 (Save / Export)」（提供单轨独立 JSON 片段导出、纯净标准 MIDI (.mid) 文件直下与一键复制数据至剪贴板）以及「实时按键录制 (Realtime REC)」（支持红光律动浮动 HUD 标牌、琴键连续拖曳试听/滑音录入与电脑键盘 QWERTY 音乐键盘实时录入，直接写入音序器与全音轨历史）。
highlights.en: **Piano Roll Clip New, Save/Export & Realtime Record**: Integrated 3 essential clip actions into Piano Roll Deck 1: "New Clip" (with safety confirmation dialog, note reset, and complete undo stack integration), "Save / Export Clip" (supporting discrete track JSON export, Type 0 Standard MIDI (.mid) generation, and 1-click clipboard copying), and "Realtime REC" (featuring a pulsating red recording HUD, 3D keybed drag/glissando capture, and QWERTY musical typing direct note wr…

highlights.zh: **工作区功能键 4 组胶囊微底色聚合与一键精简折叠（Item 8: 4-Pill Logical Grouping, Visual Capsules & Responsive Compact Fold）**：系统重塑工作区顶部工具栏为 4 大清晰逻辑功能组：播放控制组（播放/停止、BPM调节与Tap、节拍器、预备拍、录音、鼓机音色与模式、槽位）、编辑操作组（撤销/重做、拍号、量化精度、时值步长、工具模式、快速操作）、视图切换组（钢琴卷帘、虚拟键盘、独立混音台、速度/动态轨、全景频谱仪、全屏切换）与工程管理组（灵感激发、MIDI导入、工程中心、曲风工坊、多格式导出、分享与高级效果器机架）。每组使用微底色胶囊（Pill）包裹并保留 8-12px 呼吸间距。增设一键精简折叠按钮（持久化于 localStorage），折叠状态下仅保留播放控制组，次要功能优雅收起于「··· 更多」弹性下拉菜单，彻底释放编曲视界与移动端空间。
highlights.en: **4-Pill Logical Grouping, Visual Capsules & Responsive Compact Fold**: Restructured the master workstation toolbar into 4 ergonomic logical groups: Playback & Transport (Play/Stop, BPM ±/Tap, Metronome, Count-In, REC, Drum Kit, Pattern Slots), Edit Operations (Undo/Redo, Meter, Quantize, Length, Tool Mode, Quick Actions), View Switchers (Piano Roll, Musical Typing, Mixing Console, Velocity Lane, Panoramic Analyzer, Fullscreen), and Project Management (Inspire Me, MIDI Impor…

highlights.zh: **轨道头独立折叠压缩与 6 大声学分类指示器（Item 9: Single-Track Folding & 6 Acoustic Category Badges）**：在音序器每条轨道表头增设折叠切换按钮（单个轨道一键压缩至 36px 超精简模式，隐藏下层微调控件，仅保留指示色块、类型微标、音色试听 ▶、静音与独奏），并在标尺上方增设全局「全部折叠 / 全部展开」总控开关；同时为全部 8 轨智能配备专属声学分类胶囊徽标（DRUM 鼓组、PERC 打击乐、BASS 贝斯、CHORD 和弦、LEAD 主音、FX 音效），高对比度半透明彩色标签一目了然，多轨工程纵览游刃有余。
highlights.en: **Single-Track Folding & 6 Acoustic Category Badges**: Introduced individual track fold toggles that compress any track row into an ultra-compact 36px footprint (hiding secondary volume/pan/shift/clear controls while retaining color swatch, audition ▶, Mute, Solo, and category badge), paired with a global "Fold All / Expand All" master switch. Every track row features intelligent acoustic category badges (DRUM, PERC, BASS, CHORD, LEAD, FX) with high-contrast semi-transparent…
